newsitem.title: USA: US tax panel adopts corporate 'tax trap' measure.
newsitem.headline: US tax panel adopts corporate 'tax trap' measure.

text.p: The U.S. House Ways and Means Committee on Thursday adopted an amendment to tax legislation that would allow companies to offset ordinary losses against capital gains.
The measure would alleviate a problem commonly referred to as the corporate capital gains "tax trap," said Pennsylvania Republican Rep Philip English, who introduced the amendment.
The amendment was made to sweeping tax legislation being considered by the committee.

The legislation, as proposed, provided for a reduction in the corporate capital gains tax, but English said this would provide no relief in many cases when companies have both a net capital gain and an ordinary loss from operations.
The amendment was adopted on a voice vote with little debate, as Joint Committee on Taxation chief of staff Kenneth Kies said it would result in no additional cost to the government.
